title: A Lewy-type theorem for pluriharmonic mappings in $\C^2$ and bi-Lipschitz quasiconformal harmonic maps
summary: Lewy's theorem says that a one-to-one harmonic mapping between plane domains has nonvanishing Jacobian. In dimensions at least three this statement is false for general harmonic homeomorphisms. We prove a four-dimensional Lewy theorem under the additional complex-analytic assumption of pluriharmonicity. More precisely, if \[ F:Ω\subset \mathbb C^2\to \mathbb C^2 \] is a \(C^2\) pluriharmonic mapping which is one-to-one in a neighborhood of a point \(p\), then the real Jacobian of \(F\) is nonzero at \(p\).
